title: Power Rankings: Celtics sinking, Pistons back in top 10
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 10
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Throw out a winter trip to Florida that went awry and the Lakers are 10-0 since the Dec. 9 debacle in Sacramento. And so they've reclaimed the league's best record along with the top spot where it matters. (Yes, here.)

rankings.summaryHtml: It happened to the Lakers in Sacramento. It happened to the Celtics in Oakland. And now everyone in this season's runaway top three has been beaten by a bottom-feeder after the Cavs' stumble in the nation's capital.

rankings.summaryHtml: Rajon Rondo says the Celtics are absolutely, positively "not in a slump." And he's right. After a 27-2 start, I'd say losing four out of six for the first time ever in the KG-Pierce-Allen era ranks as more than a slump.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Magic are on pace to exceed last season's 27 wins on the road by two and are a sparkling 14-4 against the West. They've still got some work to do in the East, though, at a mere 2-3 against the rest of the top eight.
